title: Baba Ghanoush
description: Eggplant charred over an open flame until it collapses, then mashed with tahini, garlic, and lemon. Smoky, silky, and eaten with bread.
notes: Keeps three days in the fridge. Bring it back to room temperature before serving.

steps.text: Char the eggplants directly over a gas flame, on a barbecue, or under a very hot grill, turning, until the skin is black and they collapse.
steps.tip: The smoke is the whole dish. Oven-roasted eggplant makes a pleasant dip that is not baba ghanoush.

steps.text: Split them and leave to drain in a colander, cut side down, so the bitter juices run off.
Scrape the flesh from the skin and mash with a fork — not a blender — with the tahini, garlic, lemon juice, and salt.
Spread in a shallow bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and finish with parsley and pomegranate seeds.
